For Hashim 99, Khaled 098, lwservers' row was older than 24 hours and still showed their previous alliance (RokU); RSCL membership comes from lwatlas and LastRank, both dated later. Profession comes from lwservers' career type (pf) for 93; alliance rank is always kept, as lwservers leaves it empty or undated.
